ceramic.title: Pottery bowl used for fumigating tanned skin-clothing.
Black polished pot with some incised decoration on shoulder.

Pot with lid, both of burnished black ware. Lid [.1] hemispherical in shape with centred, rounded handle. Decorated with pattern above base. Pot [.2] with inverted rim, rounded body and flat base. Decorated with horizontal band of chevrons.
Large pot of burnished black ware. Everted rim, narrow and tall neck, globular body and rounded base. Decorated with horizontal line at base of neck. Sections of rim broken away and missing.
Large pot of burnished red ware. Everted rim, tall and narrow neck, rounded body and flat base. Decorated with linear patterns below neck, incised with pointed stick. Black firing marks on base.
Pot of burnished black ware. Upright rim and tall neck, globular protrusion then cylindrical body and flat base. Directed with linear patterns. Small chips to base.
Pot of burnished red ware. Slightly everted rim, tall and narrow neck, rounded body and flat base. Decorated at central body with horizontal band of chevrons, incised with pointed stick.

Pot of burnished red ware. Everted rim with small mouth and very narrow neck. Rounded and squat body with flat base. Decorated above shoulder with linear markings incised with a stick. Row of filled triangles bound by horizontal lines. Firing marks present, largely on base.

Pot of pink ware with pronounced everted rim, rounded body and flat, wide base. Decorated with undulating pattern filled with small line marks. Black firing marks present across body and base. Sections missing from rim.

Small pot of burnished red ware. Slightly everted rim, short neck and narrow mouth, rounded body and flat base. Decorated above the shoulder and below the neck with linear markings, incised with a fine pointed stick. Parallel lines between which large triangles pointing upwards in which are four rows of stick marks. Black firing marks on side and base.

Pot of burnished red ware. Everted rim, short neck, shouldered body and flat base. Decorated below shoulder with linear patterns incised with a stick. Four horizontal bands surrounding three rows of filled triangles. Horizontal band above base.

Black pottery pipe bowl with polished surface. Sharp elbow with cylindrical stem and flared bowl. The edge of the bowl slightly bevelled and decorated with short grooved lines; a light groove running round the top of the stem. Small fragment of stem broken off and missing.

Globular pot with a flat base, rounded shoulders, narrow neck and everted rim. The interior surface is glazed, with blackened areas extending across the vessel entirety. Below the neck is a band of horizontal notches.
Small burnished pot with straight sides and a wide rim with a short spout. The pot is decorated with incised horizontal lines below the rim and above the base.

Globular pot of orange clay with a flat base, pronounced neck with an everted rim and glazed interior. Below the neck is a band of horizontal notches. The base has blackened areas. There is evidence of historic pest and damage.
Pottery vessel, of light red clay, with an everted circular rim, long neck, bulbous body, circular foot and an open base. Light circular grooves visible above the shoulder.

Globular pot of orange clay with a flat base and narrow neck. Below the neck is a band of vertical grooves and notched pendant triangles. Upon the base and shoulder are blackened areas. The neck and rim are missing.

Small burnished pot with a flat base, globular body and long narrow neck. The rim is upright and the pot is decorated with two incised horizontal lines at the base of the neck. Pot contains a fluffy substance, possibly loose wool or cotton.
Small burnished pot with a flat base, globular body and short neck with a slightly everted rim. Decorated around the neck with a band of raised decoration and 10 hanging triangles.
Small burnished pot with a flat base, globular body and a short narrow neck with slightly everted rim. Decorated with four incised horizontal lines and multiple hanging triangles.

Small pot of burnished red ware. Everted rim, short neck and narrow mouth, rounded body tapering to a flat base. Decorated above the shoulder and below the neck with linear markings, incised with a fine pointed stick. Bound by horizontal lines are rows of short vertical lines.

Pot of burnished red ware. Everted rim with small mouth and very narrow neck, rounded body with flat base. Decorated above shoulder and below neck with linear markings incised with a stick. Three horizontal lines with filled triangles and vertical rows of short lines.

Pot of red ware. Everted rim and narrow mouth, shouldered body and flat base. Decorated below neck with linear patterns incised with a stick. Horizontal band at neck followed by irregular triangular patterns extending over the shoulder. Burnished at neck. Firing marks at base.

Pot of burnished red ware with everted rim, rounded body and flat base. Decorated below neck with two horizontal bands filled with rows of short diagonal lines. Horizontal band above base. Black firing marks present. Two small chip to the rim.
Pot of burnished red ware. Inverted rim, rounded body and flat base. Decorated with triangular patterns. Black firing marks on base. Section missing from rim.

Most of the hair has come away from the tail. The bow string is made from bamboo, knotted around both ends. The bow string has broken away from the knot on one side.

Leather quiver filled with arrows. The arrows have sagittal-shaped socketed iron heads with three or more barbs on each side: shafts slender about 540mm in length without notches, and some with leaf-feathering. The quiver is made of leather and is a flat rectangle, stitched into shape. A handle made of plaited plant fibre attached to the quiver.

Four arrows with wooden shafts and leaf fletchings. [A] has a socketed leaf shaped blade with barbed shoulders and is bound on the shaft with coiled metal. [B] has a socketed, rounded blade and is bound near the fletching with coiled metal. [C] has a socketed blade with barbed shoulders; socket is wrapped with a strip of metal. [D] has no head, the terminal is tapered to a point.
Wooden bow with cane string. Bow tapered at either end and with knobs to prevent the string slipping. Two splits in the wood.
Two bird arrows with head ends tapered to a point. [C] has a leaf fletching, and [D] is decorated at the terminal with spiral grooves. Both are darkened at the tip; possible charring.
